title: Document reusable evidence-based delivery procedures as portable skills
outcome: Document reusable evidence-based delivery procedures as portable skills
acceptance: A portable skill defines a single READY evidence manifest, evidence reuse across workspace recovery, a criterion-based rerun decision, and atomic acceptance criteria without project-specific names or commands
The team-coordination skill remains portable by delegating project-specific authority and cross-host rules to each repository's own instructions
The Markdown link check passes through the focused launcher on the changed tree
